activation_blocked_reason: Template only; explicit operator authorization instruction required. Seven locked constants must be declared before any TRANSPORT implementation PR may be opened, including LP solver variant, pivot rule, and tie-breaking strategy. This template does not constitute authorization.

required_operator_decision_fields.description: Operator declares the exact LP solver variant to be used for general m*n balanced transport problems. Must be a deterministic solver with a fixed algorithm family. Stochastic variants excluded.
Operator declares the exact pivot rule for the LP solver. Randomized pivot rules excluded. Must be fixed before implementation to ensure deterministic results.
Operator declares the tie-breaking rule for degenerate transport problems with multiple optimal transport plans. Required so that test fixtures have unique expected values.
Operator declares the exact relative balance tolerance epsilon_rel used to check |sum(supply) - sum(demand)| <= epsilon_rel * max(sum(supply), sum(demand)). Planned default: 1e-9.
Operator declares the maximum allowed m*n (number of LP decision variables). Required to bound LP solve time and memory allocation.
Operator declares the maximum allowed cost matrix entry value. Required to bound float64 overflow risk in LP objective accumulation for large cost matrices.

Operator confirms the complete enumeration of NOT_COMPUTABLE conditions: empty supply (m=0) or demand (n=0), unbalanced transport (exceeds tolerance), negative supply/demand/cost element, non-finite value, cost_matrix shape mismatch.
